basic_details.job_title: SBC Exports Purchase Officer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., an outsourcing agency supplying manpower services on contract basis to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (HBCH&RC), Muzaffarpur, has called a walk-in interview for 1 Purchase Officer post (Advt. No. OS/MUZ/2026/96, dated 05.11.2026) on 20 November 2026 between 09:00 am and 10:00 am at the hospital in Umanagar, Muzaffarpur, Bihar. Outstation candidates may attend online by emailing [email protected] so that it is received by 17 November 2026, 3:00 p.m. The pay is Rs. 60,000 per month and this is a private agency's contract engagement, not a direct government

qualification.details: Essential qualification: Graduation. Essential experience: 15 years work experience in Central / State Government / PSU / Autonomous Bodies in the field of Purchase and Stores with knowledge of Government Orders and Rules, out of which 5 years experience should be in supervisory role. Desirable: Proficiency in computer applications and knowledge in respective subject, Government rules & regulations. Age limit: 45 years, counted as on the walk-in interview date. Deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation. | The appointment is initially for a period of six months and extendable, if required. Discipline-specific graduation requirements are not printed; candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility.

content_sections.heading: SBC Exports Purchase Officer at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

rows.details: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. (outsourcing agency, for deployment at HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur)
Graduation, with 15 years' experience in Purchase and Stores
Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur (Bihar)
Walk-in interview; outstation candidates by email for online interview
Email requesting online interview: 17.11.2026 up to 3:00 p.m. Walk-in interview: 20.11.2026, 09:00 am to 10:00 am

content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur, on contract basis. The Purchase Officer will be deployed at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, located on the Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Local candidates attend the walk-in interview in person. Outstation candidates may attend the interview online. They must send their resume with the supporting documents in a single PDF file to [email protected] . The notice asks them to mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. The email must be received by 17 November 2026 up to 3:00 p.m. Venue for the walk-in: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004. Reach the venue on 20 November 2026 between 09:00 am and 10:00 am. Carry the bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original with one set of self-attested copies. If you are an outstation candidate, email the resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and copies of Aadhar and PAN Card as a single PDF to the address above. Write the post applied for in the subject line.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Graduation. Essential experience: 15 years work experience in Central / State Government / PSU / Autonomous Bodies in the field of Purchase and Stores with knowledge of Government Orders and Rules, out of which 5 years experience should be in supervisory role. Desirable: Proficiency in computer applications and knowledge in respective subject, Government rules & regulations. Age limit: 45 years, counted as on the walk-in interview date. Deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation. The appointment is initially for a period of six months and extendable, if required. Discipline-specific graduation requirements are not printed; candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through an interview, held as a walk-in at the hospital or online for outstation candidates. For the online interview, only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted. The notice does not describe any other stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. Candidates must carry originals and one set of self-attested copies of certificates. The post is on contract through the outsourcing agency, initially for six months.

faq.question: Q1. How many Purchase Officer posts has SBC Exports announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 post of Purchase Officer, for deployment at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur.

faq.question: Q2. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 20 November 2026 between 09:00 am and 10:00 am.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to email for the online interview?
faq.answer: The email requesting an online interview must be received by 17 November 2026 up to 3:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Purchase Officer?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Graduation, with 15 years' experience in Central / State Government / PSU / Autonomous Bodies in Purchase and Stores, of which 5 years should be in a supervisory role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years as on the walk-in interview date. Deserving and bright candidates may be given age relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the Purchase Officer?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.60,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry to the interview?
faq.answer: Carry bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original with one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. Can outstation candidates attend the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes. They should email the resume and documents in a single PDF to [email protected] with the post applied for in the subject line. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., initially for six months and extendable, if required.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation be provided to outstation candidates?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that accommodation will not be provided.
